short_description:
This collection mod features three starting Tier I Tomes - Tome of the Challenger (Order/Chaos), Tome of Chains (Order/Shadow) and Tome of Resonance (Astral/Materium) - all for more Affinity diversity for your custom empires!

Tome of the Challenger: Challenge your enemies to a fair fight, and gain blessings for proving yourself worthy.

Tome of Chains: Demoralize your enemies and inflict Immobilized on them to keep them in your iron grip.

Tome of Resonance: Unite different Unit Types and make them work together in arcane formations.
name: Thyron's Epic Starting Tome Collection
